name: Names
overview: Scripture reveals that names carry significant meaning and authority, as seen when Adam named the creatures, establishing identity and dominion (Genesis 2:19). God Himself changes the names of key patriarchs—Abram to Abraham, Sarai to Sarah, and Jacob to Israel—signifying divine purpose and covenantal promises (Genesis 17:5, 17:15, 32:28). The name of God is presented as eternal and memorial, underscoring His unchanging nature and faithfulness (Exodus 3:15). Additionally, a good name is valued above riches, highlighting the importance of reputation and character in the believer’s life (Proverbs 22:1).
